When dealing damage, the Damage Types are determined by the Skill used and effects which of the Protections the damage is mitigated by during Combat Calculations. Most skills deal only one damage type, however if a skill has multiple damage types the damage dealt is split amongst the damage types and each is mitigated separately by protections.

The formula for determining damage dealt from various damage types is:

Damage Dealt = [(Damage Type A + Damage Type Modifiers)+Skill Type Modifiers] + [(Damage Type B + Damage Type Modifiers)+Skill Type Modifiers] + ... + [(Damage Type N + Damage Type Modifiers)+Skill Type Modifiers]

## List of Damage Types[]

- Physical Damage

- Lightning Damage

- Cold Damage

- Fire Damage

- Void Damage

- Necrotic Damage

- Poison Damage
